notes.title: Archrebel Tactics is a galactic love letter to '80s strategy game essentials
notes.notes:
After 15 years in development and three redesigns, space strategy game Archrebel Tactics has come full circle by securing a publishing deal with Microprose. Most heavily inspired by Rebelstar, the 1986 classic from original XCOM creator Julian Gollop, Archrebel Tactics puts you in charge of a small squadron of units completing missions on a hostile alien planet. Calling to mind beloved PC names such as Laser Squad and UFO: Enemy Unknown, it's now got the financial support needed to reach completion, and you can try a demo today.

Read the rest of the story...

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/inspired-by-classics-like-ufo-enemy-unknown-xcom-archrebel-tactics-gets-microprose-backing/

notes.title: Archrebel Tactics is now proudly part of Micro Prose's gaming catalog.
notes.notes:
[p][b]A bit of context for those unfamiliar with Archrebel and my story:

Archrebel Tactics[/b]’ journey began back in 2010 and has been redesigned from scratch three times before I finally found the right formula and honed the skills needed to be worthy of reincarnating and expanding the classic formulas of [b]Rebelstar[/b] and [b]Laser Squad[/b] turn-based, tactical war games.[/p][p]Progress has been steady since 2021, when I left my job to fully dedicate myself to game development, with [b]Archrebel Tactics[/b] as the first title on my list. Unfortunately, after three years of intense work, my funds were nearly depleted, and a few ill-timed real-life events forced me to scale back to part-time development.[/p][p]That said, development is still going strong — and now, with the financial support of [b]MicroProse[/b], I have the option to return to full-time development should I feel my current pace isn’t meeting expectations. The project has never been more alive than it is now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895662/f0267eb774689079c21f441029cdef575ad7d438.png"][/img][/p][p]Since the game’s demo was released last year on[url="https://ularis-badler.itch.io/archrebel"] itch.io[/url], it has received many new features — namely (excluding bug fixes, UI improvements, and QoL additions):[/p][list][*][p][b]Target Painter[/b]  - A new item that increases the signature targets and their vulnerability to critical shots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Proximity Mine[/b] - New explosive weapon that will detonate when enemy units come adjacent to it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]EMP Grenade[/b] Launcher ammo - New EMP ammo for the grenade launcher.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hack Tool[/b] - The hack tool now can also disrupt the AP pool of target droids, at the distance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Charge Pack[/b] - New item that can recharge shields, energy weapons, and droid batteries.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cloak Field[/b] -  New item that cloaks units making them immune to ranged attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Decoy Projector[/b] -  New item that projects a ranged holographic image to bait enemy units to attack it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phoenix Shot[/b] -  New item that revive human units shortly after they have fallen in battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Webber[/b] -  New item that will grapple and hold an enemy target in place.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Neuro Gun[/b] -  New item that lets the player briefly control wild life and enemy soldiers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stun Blaster[/b] -  New item that lets the player stun living units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sentry Gun[/b] -  A one time deployable turret that automatically engages foes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sunblade[/b] -  A new deadly melee weapon for the knight class that hits multiple targets in a single strike.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Neutron Blaster[/b] -  New deadly weapon for the Elite class.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895662/020c1f0867b553a8c21bed29ed1ef96ee610632e.png"][/img][/p][p]Here’s the current milestone list to keep you up to speed. Please keep in mind that this list of planned features is not set in stone; [b]features can be added or removed at any time.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Level up system[/b] (update bonus modifiers for attributes, skills, and gear per class based on the new mechanics in place).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weather system[/b] (cloudy, partially-cloudy, foggy, rainy, thunderstorm, hazzardstorm).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Create new biomes[/b] (Desert, swamp, caves and Shardlands).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional wildlife[/b] (land, aquatic, flying, and some special ones ;).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Demo mission II[/b] (this mission will let players test unit classes and the level up system).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Campaign mode[/b] (in between missions unit management, plot development, technology research, and mission selection).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Demo mission III[/b] (this mission will let players test the campaign mode mechanics and UI).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mission/campaign editor[/b] (for both the developer and player).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiplayer[/b] (campaign co-op and PVP, integration of multiplayer in the previous demo missions).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main campaign[/b] (the development of the game's main campaign).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Integration[/b] (API integration and Steam achievements).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The best way to stay close to the game’s development is by joining my [url="https://discord.gg/BCvTjpUtvb"]Discord [/url]channel; I’ve channelized a single place for it to keep my solo development bearable and effective, even tough I still share some news on [b]X[/b] and [b]Bluesky[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]I’ll see you there, Commander![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41895662/eee81bce52dc120a9d1daeb59c53b2619aec9ea9.png"][/img][/p]
